newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Sept 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Sept 24.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Industry and Electricity Minister Yamani says there are 2,476 factories in the kingdom with total investment of $43 billion.
- Tunisia gets a $150 million loan from international banks as part of foreign financing.
- Jordanian cement company gets $15 million bank loan.
- Gulf Arab refineries' capacity rose to 3.16 million barrels per day in 1995.
- Tunisian finance minister says Tunisian bourse will start electronic operations at the end of October, seeks to list 100 companies.
- A U.S. delegation will visit Jordan to examine investment opportunities.
